name: Lucky Cat - Ihre mobile Katzenbetreuung Hamburg

description: Lucky Cat is a mobile cat-sitting service in Hamburg operating since 2014. The sitter visits cats in their own home once or twice a day, choosing from a standard 30-minute or deluxe 60-minute visit slot. Services include medication administration on request and English-speaking communication.
